description: Catalog of environmental data sources that may be joined to dated dune observations. Metadata is catalogued but not yet validated against each provider; no source here is an in-situ measurement at a dune field unless explicitly stated.

sources.name: Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer (MEDA)
sources.spatial_support: Point measurements at the rover, not areal values over a dune field.
sources.temporal_support: Irregular rover operations; intervals and gaps must be inspected.
limitations: Provider metadata and access terms have not been validated in this repository.
Rover point measurements are not simultaneous with orbital image acquisition by default.
Wind reference height and local roughness must be supplied before shear calculations.
sources.notes: Potential local weather source for Jezero; require explicit timestamps and provenance before use.

sources.name: Rover Environmental Monitoring Station (REMS)
sources.spatial_support: Point measurements at the rover in Gale Crater.
sources.temporal_support: Irregular rover operations; intervals and gaps must be inspected.
limitations: Provider metadata and access terms have not been validated in this repository.
Gale Crater is not Jezero Crater or any other dune field in this workspace.
Do not transfer local wind statistics between sites without an explicit regional model.
sources.notes: Regional in-situ context only; not a measurement at Hargraves, Coprates or Nili Patera.

sources.name: Mars Climate Database
sources.provider: Laboratoire de Meteorologie Dynamique and partners
sources.instrument: General circulation model and reanalysis products
sources.spatial_support: Model grid cell, not a point measurement.
sources.temporal_support: Model output at requested times; not an observed weather record.
limitations: Provider metadata, version and access terms have not been validated in this repository.
Model output is not an in-situ observation and must not be labelled as measured weather.
Interpolating to an image time does not make the value simultaneous with the image.
Model resolution and parameterizations must be reported with any extraction.
sources.notes: Potential climatology or boundary-condition source; keep model and observation labels distinct.

sources.name: THEMIS thermal inertia
sources.provider: Arizona State University / NASA Mars Odyssey
sources.spatial_support: Orbital retrieval on a mapped grid; footprint and quality vary.
sources.temporal_support: Multi-observation climatology or seasonal composite, not a single acquisition.
limitations: Provider metadata, product version and access terms have not been validated in this repository.
Thermal inertia is a surface property retrieval, not a wind measurement.
Do not treat a climatology composite as simultaneous weather at an image date.
sources.notes: Potential surface-property covariate; requires an explicit product and uncertainty reference.

sources.name: InSight weather service
sources.spatial_support: Point measurements at the lander in Elysium Planitia.
limitations: Provider metadata and access terms have not been validated in this repository.
Elysium Planitia is not a dune field in this workspace.
Mission coverage does not overlap all image dates.
sources.notes: Regional in-situ context only; do not transfer to other sites without an explicit model.
